svg.title: Lac de Lacanau bathymetry — Taubin-faired integer isobaths
svg.desc: Corrected GeoPDF 4.1 depth classes. v4.4 Gaussian occupancy iso-contours are followed by sparse non-shrinking Taubin curve smoothing, Douglas-Peucker simplification, and cumulative parent clipping. GPS lookup remains untouched v4.1 classes.
